use_snapshot <- FALSE

snapshot_file <- "depmap-gene-effect-2026-11-18.csv"
snapshot_url  <- paste0("https://henriksson-lab.github.io/course_cellbiology/",

# The data

A CRISPR screen knocks out one gene in many cancer cell lines and measures
growth. The **gene effect** is 0 when the cells grow normally and about −1 for a
typical essential gene. This code fetches the gene effects for six genes from
the Open Targets API (which redistributes the DepMap data). You do not need to
change it.

```{r fetch}
genes <- c(CDK1 = "ENSG00000170312", CDK4 = "ENSG00000135446",
           CDK6 = "ENSG00000105810", BCL2 = "ENSG00000171791",
           MCL1 = "ENSG00000143384", BCL2L1 = "ENSG00000171552")

fetch_gene <- function(symbol, ensembl_id) {
  query <- sprintf('{ target(ensemblId: "%s") { depMapEssentiality {
    tissueName screens { cellLineName geneEffect } } } }', ensembl_id)
  resp <- POST("https://api.platform.opentargets.org/api/v4/graphql",
               body = list(query = query), encode = "json",
               user_agent("3MB001-course"), timeout(60))
  stop_for_status(resp)
  resp <- content(resp, as = "parsed", simplifyVector = FALSE)
  or_na <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA else x
  rows <- list()
  for (tissue in resp$data$target$depMapEssentiality) {
    for (screen in tissue$screens) {
      if (is.null(screen$geneEffect)) next
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        gene = symbol, tissue = or_na(tissue$tissueName),
        cell_line = or_na(screen$cellLineName), gene_effect = screen$geneEffect)
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

read_snapshot <- function() {
  local_file <- file.path("data", snapshot_file)
  read.csv(if (file.exists(local_file)) local_file else snapshot_url)
}

dependencies <- NULL
if (!use_snapshot) {
  dependencies <- tryCatch({
    rows <- lapply(names(genes), function(g) fetch_gene(g, genes[[g]]))
    do.call(rbind, rows)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(dependencies)) data_source <- paste("Open Targets API, retrieved", Sys.Date())
}
if (is.null(dependencies)) dependencies <- read_snapshot()

dependencies <- dependencies[, c("gene", "tissue", "cell_line", "gene_effect")]
head(dependencies)
```

Data: `r data_source`. The table has `r nrow(dependencies)` rows
(one gene in one cell line per row).

# Blank 3: BCL2 by tissue

Keep only the rows of **BCL2**, the target of venetoclax. Replace `___` with
the gene name, in quotes.

```{r bcl2, fig.height = 8}
bcl2 <- dependencies[dependencies$gene == ___, ]

ggplot(bcl2, aes(x = reorder(tissue, gene_effect, FUN = min), y = gene_effect)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -1, linetype = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Tissue of origin", y = "BCL2 gene effect")

# Cell lines that strongly need BCL2 (gene effect below -1), per tissue:
sort(table(bcl2$tissue[bcl2$gene_effect < -1]), decreasing = TRUE)
```
